description: This file is a C header file defining the interface for UBUS communication within the BBFDM system. It contains type definitions for callback functions, function declarations for initializing, freeing, invoking, and sending events over UBUS, as well as macros to simplify usage. The file appears to be part of an API for UBUS interaction, defining external symbols and function signatures for UBUS operations.

methods.name: bbfdm_init_ubus_ctx
methods.description: Initializes the UBUS context within the BBFDM system, returning 0 on success and -1 on failure.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_ubus_ctx
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the UBUS context within the BBFDM system, returning 0 on success.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_invoke_sync
methods.description: Invokes a UBUS method synchronously with a callback for the response. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_invoke_async
methods.description: Invokes an asynchronous UBUS method with callbacks for data and completion. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_send_event
methods.description: Sends an event to a UBUS object with the specified message data.
